dev_notes: src/commands/migrate.mjs works on the raw JSON, since the model refuses the old shape. Released versions' bullets go verbatim into compositions.json; the open release's become `combined` events plus a draft composition, stamped only if it was current. dev_notes move to the feature; `paths`, questions.json, summaries.json, reviews.json and audits.json go. Archives under .ledger/archive/ are migrated too. Idempotent: a current ledger is left alone.

history.name: Upgrading an older ledger
history.description: The command ledger migrate brings a ledger from an earlier version of the tool up to date, and every edition already handed over prints as before. An old-shape feature file is refused until migrated.
history.how_to_see: In a ledger made by an earlier version, run ledger migrate --dry-run: it lists what it would convert and writes nothing. On a current ledger, it says there is nothing to migrate.
